text:
Zoe: OK team — final sync for the 1766 release announcement. Need: changelog URL, docs link, canary timing, and any messaging gotchas for the blog/post + webinar. Who can confirm?

Raj: Changelog is up: https://redwood.com/changelog/1766 — small API param rename in chat.generate (param: 'max_tokens' -> 'token_budget'). Not breaking if callers use SDK 2.1+; we'll include migration note. ETA on docs update: EOD today.

Emi: Thanks Raj. For the webinar we want 3 slides on performance: p50 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and quantify caching wins. Can we get benchmark numbers by noon?

Paul: I'll push perf numbers from canary infra. Canary window: 2026-03-25 09:00–11:00 PST. Deploy bot will post job. Note: enabling `prefix_cache=v2` requires a schema bump — ops-sre to approve DB flag.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for release/1766 -> canary at 2026-03-25T09:00Z (job id: cb-1766-01).

ops-sre: Approving DB flag — rolling enable, monitoring snapshot will be in console under /releases/1766/metrics. I'll watch tail of logs.

Zoe: @Raj can you add the migration note to the changelog top and paste a one-paragraph blurb we can use in the launch post? Need it to be <120 words.

Raj: Copied below — use as-is or tweak: 'Chat API: parameter rename to token_budget improves clarity and unifies limits across SDKs. Most callers see no action; clients pinned to older SDKs should upgrade to SDK 2.1+ or map max_tokens→token_budget. Backwards-compat is available via the compat shim for 30 days.'

Emi: Perfect. Also—we'll run a short pre-webinar benchmark demo: show 40% cost reduction w/ caching on a 32k context prompt. Paul pls attach the perf graph (png) to the doc.

Paul: Uploading graphs to docs: https://redwood.com/docs/benchmarks/1766/perf-graphs.png

Zoe: Inbound lead routing: marketing needs hook to HubSpot. @Raj / @ops-sre who owns the webhook creds? We want leads mapped to 'product_launch_1766' pipeline.

Raj: Ops-sre manages creds. Ops-sre: can you create the webhook and send creds to secure channel (1password)?

ops-sre: I'll create webhook, ACL it to marketing-role, post secret to 1Password CI vault, tag @Zoe when ready. ETA: 3pm PT.

Zoe: :thumbsup: Last ask — docs link we point to from announcement (public): https://redwood.com/docs/release-notes/1766 and full changelog link (internal): https://redwood.com/internal/changelog/1766 — confirm those.

Raj: Public doc is live at https://redwood.com/docs/release-notes/1766 — internal changelog link ok. Also flag: the small schema bump triggers a migration note for Dedicated customers; Customer success to notify top 10 tenants.

Emi: I'll draft the webinar script and slide notes and share in the thread. Can we book the webinar slot for 3pm PT on release day? marketing calendar says 2026-03-25 15:00 PT — confirm.

Zoe: Booked. Final checklist: copy for blog + hero metrics (Raj/Paul), screenshots (Paul), webhook (ops-sre), webinar slides (Emi), embargo window and press contacts. If no blockers, we'll send embargoed assets to PR by EOD tomorrow.

Paul: No blockers on runtime side. Will add sample curl for the migration shim to docs: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat.generate -d '{"token_budget":1024}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'`

Raj: Added the migration snippet to changelog and docs. Ping me if you need a shorter quote for the blog.

Zoe: Thanks all — will assemble assets and share a release package. :party_parrot:
